name: useAppFunctions
summary: Exposes on-device actions and hardware capabilities to system AI and Gemini Assistant.
plain: Bridges Android 16/17 AppFunctions (API 36+). Allows Gemini and local agents to discover and execute in-app functions, query Tensor silicon thermals, and register custom agentic tool handlers.
description: Backed by android.app.appfunctions.IAppFunctionManager (system service 133 on Pixel 11 Pro). Exposes built-in hardware actions ('check_phone_thermals', 'purge_memory_cache', 'get_device_silicon_info') and enables developers to register custom AppFunction schemas and handlers dynamically. Reports source: 'hardware' when backed by the real system service.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether AppFunctions subsystem is supported on this Android OS version (API 36+ / Android 16 QPR & Android 17).

returns.name: serviceFound
returns.desc: Whether the android.app.appfunctions.IAppFunctionManager system service is active and discoverable on device.

returns.name: apiLevel
returns.desc: Android platform API level reported by the device (37 on Pixel 11 Pro).

returns.name: functions
returns.desc: All registered AppFunction schemas available to Gemini, agents, or local invocation.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Latest execution or system service error.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Provenance of AppFunctions state. Real hardware with active app_function service reports 'hardware'.

returns.name: executeFunction
returns.desc: Executes a registered AppFunction or built-in hardware action.

returns.name: registerFunction
returns.type: (schema: AppFunctionSchema, handler: (params: Record<string, any>) => Promise<any> | any) => void
returns.desc: Registers a custom AppFunction handler accessible to on-device agents.

actions.name: executeFunction(functionId, params?)
actions.desc: Executes a registered AppFunction or built-in hardware action.

actions.name: registerFunction(schema, handler)
actions.desc: Registers a custom AppFunction handler accessible to on-device agents.
